title: PCR Prep and Pooling with 384 Plates - Stage 3
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Transfer 3 µL from odd A columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 µL of sample from plate in position 8 (PCR 2 Plate) columns A1, A3, A5, A7, etc. to the designated destination.

steps.title: Transfer 3 µL from even A columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 µL of sample from plate in position 8 (PCR 2 Plate) columns A2, A4, A6, A8, etc. to the designated destination.

steps.title: Transfer 3 µL from odd B columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 µL of sample from plate in position 8 (PCR 2 Plate) columns B1, B3, B5, B7, etc. to the designated destination.

steps.title: Transfer 3 µL from even B columns
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 µL of sample from plate in position 8 (PCR 2 Plate) columns B2, B4, B6, B8, etc. to the designated destination.
